title: pycnanthemum incanum var. tullia
intro: Pycnanthemum incanum var. tullia, commonly known as Mountain Mint, is a perennial plant native to North America, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as relief from colds, coughs, and sore throats due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions include serving as a bronchodilator and anti-spasmodic, making it useful for respiratory issues and muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Mint include phenolic compounds like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
